title: Send named data
summary: Django: Send named data. Add an author field.
introduction: JsonResponse turns a Python dictionary into JSON. Open GET /book/.

blocks.text: Install django~=5.2, run django-admin startproject school, then enter school. Replace school/urls.py with each example and run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. These view examples need no database tables.

blocks.title: Send named data

blocks.text: JsonResponse converts the dictionary to JSON. Python True would become JSON true when used in a field.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a dictionary by default; lists need safe=False.

seo.title: Django: Send named data
